rationales.a1: This video is the strongest candidate as its title and description directly address the lesson objectives: explaining MCP clearly and diving into its core components. It appears to be a conceptual overview suitable for an introduction.
rationales.a2: This is a general news roundup video. While it might mention MCP, it lacks the structured educational focus required to teach the specific lesson objectives.
rationales.a3: While highly relevant to the topic, this video focuses on a hands-on tutorial and coding ('build a tool-using agent'). It is less suitable for a general 'Introduction' lesson compared to a conceptual explanation, but still valuable as supplementary material.
